title: Recurring template hub — tabs
question: Event hub uses Details · Registrations · Forms · Settings (Images live in Details panels; no attendees on a template). How should the recurring template hub’s peer tabs work?

options.label: Details · Past events · Recurrence · Settings
options.thesis: Same quiet header and overview-led Details as the event hub. Past events and Recurrence stay peer tabs; Images folds into Details via Change photo like event hub.
options.viewport: Title + peer tabs. Details: preview + when/where + Edit / Change photo panels. Past events list. Recurrence schedule form. Settings flush switches.
options.risk: Four tabs instead of event hub’s four — but different jobs, so parity is conceptual not identical.

options.label: Details · Past events · Settings
options.thesis: Three peer tabs. Recurrence schedule lives inside Settings (or a Settings sub-section); Details matches event hub including photo panel.
options.viewport: Quieter nav. Settings stage holds template preferences + recurrence schedule blocks.
options.risk: Schedule edits compete with payment/waitlist toggles on one tab.

options.label: Keep all five legacy tabs
options.thesis: Restyle Details · Past Events · Recurrence · Images · Settings in event-hub header, but keep Images as its own peer tab.
options.viewport: Same five destinations as today; only the shell and Details overview change.
options.risk: Diverges from event hub’s Images-in-Details decision; two photo surfaces.
